name: aigpu-b2
description: Pre-silicon target architecture profile: AI-GPU B2 reticle-class 128-core datacenter AI GPU (8 clusters x 16 RV64X cores, TFR/WGMMA FEDP2K PE_RATIO=1 + TFRv2/TMEM/2D-NoC/HBM3E/UCIe2/GigaThread/MIG architectural target, graphics disabled; NOT measured physical silicon).

sources.evidence_status: PRE-SILICON TARGET ARCHITECTURE PROFILE ONLY: not measured physical silicon, not physical FPGA hardware, and not full-chip foundry sign-off. Modeled parameters are architectural targets derived for analytical comparison, RTL/SimX design contracts, and open-source pre-silicon evaluation; no physical silicon timing or foundry PPA sign-off is claimed.
sources.xlen: 64-bit RV64IMAFD compute architecture (48-bit physical / SV48 IOMMU virtual address space); configure --profile=aigpu-b2 selects build64 and build32 rejects the profile.
sources.NUM_CLUSTERS, NUM_CORES: 8 clusters x 16 cores per cluster = 128 cores total arranged on a 4x2 coherent 2D Mesh NoC reticle-class die (~740-810 mm^2 N4P estimate <= 858 mm^2 reticle ceiling).
sources.NUM_WARPS, NUM_THREADS, ISSUE_WIDTH, FET: 32 warps x 32 threads per core with 4-wide warp-slice issue and 4-wide fetch.
sources.NUM_ALU_LANES, NUM_FPU_LANES, NUM_LSU_LA: 32 ALU and 32 FP32 FPU lanes per processing block (16384 total FP32 lanes across 128 cores x 4 issue blocks x 32 lanes) paired with 8 LSU lanes per block.
sources.DCACHE_SIZE, DCACHE_MSHR_SIZE, DCACHE_NU: 128 KiB L1 D-cache per core (131072 B, 4 ways, 64 B lines, 4 banks => 128 sets/bank), 24 MSHR entries per bank.
sources.LMEM_ENABLE, LMEM_LOG_SIZE, LMEM_SIZE, L: 128 KiB local shared memory per core (131072 B, LMEM_LOG_SIZE=17 <= 18 WGMMA smem descriptor limit) across 16 8-byte banks; paired in the B2 RTL pillar with 256 KiB/core dedicated banked TMEM (32 MiB/die total).
sources.VM_ENABLE, EXT_A_ENABLE, EXT_ZACAS_ENABL: Virtual memory, RV64A atomics + Zacas compare-and-swap, Zfhmin half-precision loads/conversions, 16-lane MUFU transcendental unit, and 16 hardware barriers.
sources.EXT_TCU_ENABLE, TCU_TYPE, TCU_PE_RATIO,: Native TFR tensor cores and STD scalar FPU (zero DPI substitution) with PE_RATIO=1 and VX_CFG_TCU_FEDP2K=1 (integer literal 1 as required by ci/gen_config.py for non-_ENABLE numeric knobs). Enables WGMMA, FP16/BF16, TF32, FP8/BF8, MX microscaling, MXFP4, NVFP4, INT8, and 2:4 structured sparsity; base Vortex resolved TFR peak is 1,048.576 TFLOPS FP16 @ 2.0 GHz, while the B2 TFRv2/tcgen05 16x8x8 wide systolic pillar targets 1,152 TFLOPS FP16 / 2,304 TFLOPS FP8 / 4,608 TOPS FP4 dense (2x with 2:4 sparsity).
sources.EXT_DXA_ENABLE: Cluster-level async tensor DMA copy/multicast engine (5D TMA-class DXA with hardware decompression hook) enabled.
sources.EXT_TEX_ENABLE, EXT_RASTER_ENABLE, EXT_O: Explicitly false: AI-only datacenter pruning removes graphics and ray-tracing pipelines.
sources.L2_ENABLE, L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_: 128 MiB distributed L2/SLC across 8 coherent MOESI directory slices (134217728 B, 16 ways, 64 banks, 128 B sectored lines), 192 MSHRs/bank.
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_PEA: Pre-silicon architectural target: modeled 2000 MHz core clock and 8-stack HBM3E 4,000 GB/s (4000000 MB/s) bandwidth modeled on Vortex's HBM3 enum (VX_config.toml supports HBM2/HBM3/GDDR6) across 64 power-of-two 128-bit pseudo-channels at 3906 MT/s; paired in the B2 SoC specification with 10 TB/s UCIe 2.0 coherent D2D, PCIe Gen6 x16 DMA/IOMMU SV48, GigaThread 64-queue CP, MIG, RAS/ECC, and Confidential Computing.
sources.reference: Modeled analytical pre-silicon target figures (fp32_lanes=16384, dram_bandwidth_gbs=4000, dram_peak_bytes_per_cycle=2000, clock_mhz=2000, num_cores=128, l2_size_mib=128, tcu_blocks_total=512) checked by ci/profile_check.py --metrics=peak. Explicitly NOT physical silicon measurements.
